name: Facet
text: Add a floating, always-visible legend that updates in real time as the user hovers over nodes or edges. This keeps the interface lively and self-explanatory without cluttering the main view. The trade-off is a small loss of screen space, but the gain in clarity and speed of understanding outweighs it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that updates on hover risks hiding critical controls when the user needs them most—like when they’re adjusting filters mid-analysis. Better: embed the legend in a collapsible sidebar that stays out of the way until explicitly opened; settle it with a quick A/B test measuring error rates and task completion time.
